literal: Darkness having departed, happiness will yield, to those of blemish-free vision, delusion having departed.
translation: For those who possess a flawless vision free from delusion, the darkness of ignorance will depart, yielding true happiness.
modern: மயக்கம் நீங்கி, குற்றமற்ற மெய்யறிவு பெற்றவர்க்கு, அறியாமை என்னும் இருள் விலகி, அது பேரின்பத்தைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the transformative power of true perception. For those who have freed themselves from delusion (மருள்) and attained a flawless, blemish-free vision (மாசறு காட்சி) of reality, the darkness of ignorance (இருள்) is completely removed. In its place, they experience a lasting and profound happiness (இன்பம்). The poet contrasts the darkness of delusion with the light of pure vision, showing that spiritual clarity naturally leads to ultimate bliss.
